name: Sonnet quality compounders
strategy: Concentrate in high-ROIC wide-moat compounders (mega-cap tech, payments, healthcare) with durable pricing power, add a small tactical short against frothy small-caps, and hold meaningful cash after a weak H1.

positions.thesis: Azure/AI infrastructure plus Office moat, fortress balance sheet, best-in-class ROIC compounder.
Search moat plus Gemini/cloud optionality trading at a reasonable multiple after lagging AI-infra peers.
Custom AI silicon and networking moat with high recurring software margins; recent memory/optics correction gives a better entry.
GLP-1 franchise dominance, pricing power, pipeline depth; healthcare compounder that lagged the AI-led H1 rally.
Toll-booth payments network, near-100% incremental margins, minimal credit risk, resilient through cycles.
Duopoly payments moat alongside V, consistent double-digit compounding with low capital intensity.
Membership-model moat, loyal customer base, defensive quality compounder to balance tech-heavy book.
Small caps rallied 19.4% in H1 on low-quality, rate-sensitive, weak-balance-sheet names; fade the move as a quality-vs-junk hedge.
Deep value healthcare compounder beaten down on margin fears, strong moat in scale and data, contrarian quality add.

outlook: Expect AI-infrastructure leadership to consolidate into higher-quality, higher-ROIC names after the recent correction, with small-caps vulnerable to a reversal; staying long quality compounders with a hedge and healthy cash cushion balances upside participation with round-1 lessons on drawdown control.
